content.text: In Zimbabwe, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-live|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-7|Tron USDT]]-every-detail-you-2|digital]] creators face a harsh reality: Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, crippling their ability to sell digital products. This infrastructure gap can be closed with the right tools. Supabase, as an order database, offers a sovereign commerce solution, giving creators control over their sales and customer data. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The Edge Commerce Stack is built on a foundation of sovereignty, ensuring that you, the creator, own and control your commerce infrastructure. This means that once deployed, you have complete access to your customer data, order history, and sales analytics. Supabase, as the order database, provides a scalable and secure solution for managing your digital store's backend. By leveraging this infrastructure, you can bypass the limitations imposed by Stripe and PayPal, and focus on growing your business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, you'll need to prepare a few essential components. This includes setting up a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, creating a Supabase instance for order management, and configuring your crypto payment gateway. You'll also need to prepare your digital products, including ebooks, courses, or software, for instant delivery. With these components in place, you can begin the deployment process, which typically takes 48 hours to complete.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The payment and delivery pipeline is a critical component of the Edge Commerce Stack. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, with a low 0.5% fee per transaction. Once a payment is confirmed, the system automatically delivers the digital product to the customer. This pipeline is fully automated, ensuring a seamless experience for both you and your customers. By leveraging this pipeline, you can focus on creating and marketing your digital products, rather than managing payments and deliveries.
Deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure today.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once the Edge Commerce Stack is deployed, you can go live and start processing transactions. This involves configuring your store's frontend, setting up your products, and testing the payment and delivery pipeline. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can process transactions on the mainnet, ensuring that your sales are secure and transparent. As you process your first transaction, you'll gain confidence in the infrastructure, and be able to focus on growing your business and expanding your customer base.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed to scale with your business, providing a flexible and adaptable solution for managing your orders, customers, and sales. With Supabase, you can easily scale your order database, and with NOWPayments, you can process transactions with low fees and high security. By leveraging these components, you can focus on marketing and growing your business, rather than managing infrastructure and scaling challenges.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Scale your digital store with confidence.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy the Edge Commerce Stack, follow these steps: set up your GitHub or Cloudflare account, create a Supabase instance, configure your crypto payment gateway, prepare your digital products, and deploy the stack. Once deployed, test your payment and delivery pipeline, configure your store's frontend, and go live. With these steps, you can establish a sovereign commerce infrastructure and start selling your digital products with confidence.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Supabase?
Supabase is an open-source, PostgreSQL-based database that provides a scalable and secure solution for managing your digital store's backend.
How do I set up NOWPayments?
NOWPayments can be set up by creating an account, configuring your crypto payment gateway, and integrating it with your Supabase instance.
What is the Edge Commerce Stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack is a comprehensive solution for digital creators, offering a sovereign commerce infrastructure that includes Supabase, NOWPayments, and GitHub or Cloudflare hosting.
How do I scale my infrastructure?
You can scale your infrastructure by leveraging the flexible and adaptable components of the Edge Commerce Stack, including Supabase and NOWPayments.
What is the cost of the Edge Commerce Stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack is available for $197, and includes deployment, configuration, and testing.
